summary:
I mapped the fork at master 8c49d85 by reading the code only; I did not launch or build anything. One Electron BrowserWindow runs the UI with nodeIntegration:true, contextIsolation:false and no preload; src/preload.js contains only comments. src/index.html loads lit-based ES-module components plus two classic <script> tags. One of them, script.js, does not exist under src/. The other, utils/renderer.js, uses CommonJS require() and resolves paths relative to index.html. The main process owns storage, the Gemini Live websocket, the cloud websocket, Ollama/Whisper (local mode), Groq HTTP, global shortcuts, the tray and the uiohook Alt/Option-tap hide.

System audio is captured differently on each platform:
- **macOS:** the main process runs the bundled SystemAudioDump binary. It produces 24 kHz stereo audio, which is converted to mono, resampled to 16 kHz and sent to Gemini Live (gemini.js:1509-1600). The renderer AudioWorklet runs only in mic modes.
- **Windows and Linux:** the renderer calls getDisplayMedia, which goes through the main-process setDisplayMediaRequestHandler (sources[0] plus audio:'loopback'). Audio then flows AudioWorklet → `send-audio-frame` IPC → routeAudioFrame. For BYOK and local modes this is 16 kHz.

So on Windows the AudioWorklet/`send-audio-frame` path is the only route for system audio. On a Mac in the default speaker_only mode that path never runs.

Windows-relevant asymmetries I noticed:
- **Gap filler is macOS-only.** LiveAudioGapFiller, whose comment says Gemini 3.8 Live only closes a turn while trailing audio keeps arriving and avoids digital zeros, is started only inside startMacOSAudioCapture (gemini.js:1544). On Windows it never runs.
- **Picker failure can hang capture.** The display-media handler (window.js:149-156) has no .catch and never calls `callback` if getSources rejects or returns nothing. [INFERENCE] getDisplayMedia, and with it the session start, would hang.
- **Provider mode defaults to cloud.** It defaults to 'cloud' when the providerMode preference is unset (CheatingDaddyApp.js:748, MainView.js:541, renderer.js:697), and DEFAULT_PREFERENCES in storage.js has no providerMode. A fresh Windows profile therefore starts in cloud mode and needs a cloudToken, unlike a Mac where BYOK was already selected.
- **Unheard or dead IPC.** Main sends `session-initializing`, but no renderer listener exists. `send-audio-content`, `send-mic-audio-content`, `get-current-session`, `start-new-session` and `log-message` have handlers but no renderer callers.
- **Missing and unused files.** components/index.js exports a nonexistent AdvancedView.js, but it is never loaded. utils/windowResize.js has no callers.
- **Electron 44 ABI.** Native modules (uiohook-napi, onnxruntime-node, sharp) must be rebuilt for the Electron 44 ABI on Windows. If uiohook fails to load, the error is caught (optionTapMonitor.js:16-25) and only Alt-tap hide is lost.

The main agent may want to diff these paths against upstream/master 3cccc36; I did not do that comparison.
architecture:
## 1. Process model
- **Main process**: `src/index.js` (package.json `main`). The first line exits on `electron-squirrel-startup` (index.js:1-3). It appends Chromium switches per platform (index.js:10-19). On `whenReady` it runs `storage.initializeStorage()` → (darwin only) a `desktopCapturer.getSources` permission poke → `createMainWindow()` (utils/window.js `createWindow`) → `createTray()` → `startDiagnostics` (writes `<logs>/diagnostics/performance.jsonl`) → `setupGeminiIpcHandlers` (gemini.js:1838) → `setupStorageIpcHandlers` (index.js:144) → `setupGeneralIpcHandlers` (index.js:352). Renderer recovery: `did-fail-load`, `render-process-gone` and `unresponsive` show a dialog (index.js:57-97). There is also a 10 s `renderer-ready` handshake timeout that force-shows the window.
- **BrowserWindow** (window.js:123-146): frame:false, alwaysOnTop, hasShadow:false, autoHideMenuBar, `transparent = platform!=='win32'`, `show = platform==='win32'`, `backgroundColor` '#0a0a0a' on win32 and '#00000000' elsewhere, `skipTaskbar: isWin`, `roundedCorners: !isWin`. webPreferences: **nodeIntegration: true, contextIsolation: false, no `preload`** (src/preload.js is an empty comment stub and is not referenced), backgroundThrottling:false, enableBlinkFeatures:'GetDisplayMedia', webSecurity:true. Afterwards: setResizable(false) and setVisibleOnAllWorkspaces(true,{visibleOnFullScreen:true}). It loads `src/index.html` via `loadFile(path.join(__dirname,'../index.html'))`.
- **Display media**: `session.defaultSession.setDisplayMediaRequestHandler((req,cb)=>desktopCapturer.getSources({types:['screen']}).then(s=>cb({video:s[0],audio:'loopback'})),{useSystemPicker:true})` (window.js:148-157). It has no catch or empty-sources guard. `useSystemPicker` only has an effect on macOS.
- **Renderer load order** (src/index.html, tail of body): `assets/marked-4.3.0.min.js` and `assets/highlight-11.9.0.min.js` (classic scripts) → highlight CSS → `<script type="module" src="components/app/CheatingDaddyApp.js">`. That module statically imports lit-core-2.7.4 and MainView, CustomizeView, HelpView, HistoryView, AssistantView, OnboardingView, AICustomizeView and FeedbackView. Then come `<cheating-daddy-app id="cheatingDaddy">`, `<script src="script.js">` (the file does not exist in src/, so it 404s) and `<script src="utils/renderer.js">`, a classic script that uses Node `require('electron')` and `require('./utils/overlayVisibility')`. Relative requires resolve from src/index.html; commit 133406a fixed this. CSP: `script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'`.
- ES-module components reach Node through `window.require('electron')` and `window.require('./utils/answerEvents' | './utils/sessionController' | './utils/visibleAnswerRange')`. AppHeader.js:192 uses bare `require`. Global glue: `window.cheatingDaddy` (renderer.js:1113-1155) exposes storage wrappers, initializeGemini/Cloud/Local, startCapture/stopCapture, sendTextMessage, handleShortcut, theme, getVersion, isLinux/isMacOS/isWindows. renderer.js:1157-1161 sends `renderer-ready` after `cheating-daddy-app` upgrades.
- **Audio worklet**: `src/audio-worklet.js` (`meeting-pcm-processor`) is loaded with `audioContext.audioWorklet.addModule(new URL('./audio-worklet.js', location.href))` (renderer.js:646). It averages the input channels and posts Int16 frames of `sampleRate*0.04` samples.
- **Packaging** (forge.config.js): asar with unpack glob for onnxruntime-node, onnxruntime-common, @huggingface/transformers, sharp, @img and uiohook-napi. `extraResource: ['./src/assets/SystemAudioDump']` is copied on every platform. Makers: squirrel (no platform filter, so Windows by default), dmg (darwin), AppImage (linux). Plugins: auto-unpack-natives and Fuses (RunAsNode off, OnlyLoadAppFromAsar on, EmbeddedAsarIntegrityValidation on, CookieEncryption on). package.json: electron 44.3.0, forge 7.11.2. deps: @google/genai ^2.19, @huggingface/transformers ^3.8.1, ollama, uiohook-napi ^1.5.5, ws ^8.19, electron-squirrel-startup. optionalDeps: @img/sharp-win32-x64. overrides: node-abi 3.96.0.

## 2. Module responsibilities
**Main process**
- `src/index.js`: entry point. Squirrel exit, Chromium feature switches, tray (Show / Stop meeting / Quit), renderer crash recovery, storage IPC (`storage:*`) and general IPC (renderer-ready, get-app-version, quit-application, open-external, log-message), app lifecycle.
- `src/utils/window.js`: creates the BrowserWindow, display-media handler, content protection, Windows z-order/taskbar handling, Alt/Option-tap hide hookup, default keybinds, `updateGlobalShortcuts` (move, toggleVisibility, Windows Ctrl+\\ fallback, click-through, nextStep via executeJavaScript, prev/next response, scroll, emergencyErase), window IPC (view-changed resizes to 850x400 or 1100x800, window-minimize, update-keybinds, toggle-window-visibility, update-sizes no-op).
- `src/utils/overlayVisibility.js`: pure per-platform helpers (Alt keycodes 56/3640, chord detection, default toggle key, keybind migration, show vs showInactive, transparency, background colour, show-on-create, alpha clamp).
- `src/utils/optionTapMonitor.js`: global keyboard hook via `uiohook-napi` that detects a lone Alt/Option tap and toggles the overlay. Asks for macOS Accessibility; on other platforms it is a no-op returning true.
- `src/utils/windowBounds.js`: `clampBoundsToWorkArea` keeps the window on screen after display changes.
- `src/utils/screenStill.js`: main-process screenshot via `desktopCapturer.getSources({types:['screen'],thumbnailSize})`. Picks the primary display, encodes JPEG (40/60/85 %) at max 1280 px width, maps macOS permission errors.
- `src/utils/diagnostics.js`: every 15 s appends memory, app metrics and `global.getMeetingDiagnostics()` to `<logs>/diagnostics/performance.jsonl`, rotating at 5 MB.
- `src/storage.js`: JSON-file storage in an OS-specific config dir (config, credentials, preferences, keybinds, limits), Groq/Gemma usage limits, and the `HistoryStore` facade.

**AI providers / session (main)**
- `src/utils/gemini.js` (~2,239 lines): the session hub. Provider-mode state (`byok`/`cloud`/`local`), Gemini Live session init/reconnect/resumption, transcript ingestion, answer streaming (`answer-event`), typed-turn queue, code-answer card (gemini-3.8-flash), screen analysis routing, Groq fallback (Whisper STT plus chat), Gemma, meeting summary (gemini-3.1-flash-lite), macOS SystemAudioDump spawn and stop, audio routing (`routeAudioFrame`), and all session IPC handlers (gemini.js:1838-2220).
- `src/utils/geminiLiveTransport.js`: raw `ws` client to `wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContent?key=…`. Sends `setup`, resolves on `setupComplete`, 15 s setup timeout. Exposes sendRealtimeInput, sendClientContent, sendToolResponse and bufferedBytes.
- `src/utils/geminiLiveSessionConfig.js`: Live setup config. AUDIO modality, input and output transcription, automatic VAD (LOW sensitivity, silence 800 or 1200 ms), START_OF_ACTIVITY_INTERRUPTS, context compression, system instruction. Contains uncommitted user prompt edits.
- `src/utils/liveAudioGapFiller.js`: injects low-amplitude noise frames when real audio stops for ≥300 ms so Gemini 3.8 Live can close turns. Only started by the macOS SystemAudioDump path.
- `src/utils/liveTurnWatchdog.js`: finishes a Live turn that stalls without `turnComplete`.
- `src/utils/analyzeScreenSend.js`: chooses the screen-analysis path (cloud/local/http/live/groq), builds the gemini-3.8-flash request and the Live screen-context turn.
- `src/utils/answerFormatting.js`: formats Live transcript answers; `needsCodeAnswer` heuristic.
- `src/utils/answerEvents.js`: turn IDs and `emitAnswer` (send `answer-event`); `applyAnswerEvent` reducer used by the renderer.
- `src/utils/audioPipeline.js`: `BoundedAudioQueue`, `PcmChunker`, `mixPcm16`, `validateAudioFrame` (16k/24k, ≤64 KiB, even length).
- `src/utils/boundedTurnQueue.js`: queue of up to 3 pending typed questions.
- `src/utils/connectionGeneration.js`: generation token that discards callbacks from stale connections.
- `src/utils/historyStore.js`: incremental JSONL session archive (`<id>.jsonl` plus `<id>.meta.json`) and `buildRelevantContext` retrieval.
- `src/utils/cloud.js`: cloud provider websocket `wss://api.cheatingdaddy.com/ws?token=…`. Messages: set_config, binary PCM, test_text, image, end_connection. Receives transcription and response_* events.
- `src/utils/localai.js`: local provider. `ollama` client (default host http://127.0.0.1:11434, model llama3.1), `@huggingface/transformers` Whisper (default Xenova/whisper-small, q8, cache in `userData/whisper-models`), RMS VAD at 16 kHz, image questions via Ollama `images`.
- `src/utils/transcriptOverlap.js`: removes repeated words between overlapping STT segments.
- `src/utils/prompts.js`: profile system prompts and `getSystemPrompt`. Contains uncommitted user edits.
- `src/audioUtils.js`: `saveDebugAudio` helper used when `DEBUG_AUDIO` is set.

**Renderer glue**
- `src/utils/renderer.js`: classic script. Storage IPC wrapper, provider init (`initialize-gemini|cloud|local`), capture (`startCapture`: macOS uses SystemAudioDump via IPC, Windows/Linux use `getDisplayMedia` loopback, plus optional getUserMedia mic, both fed into the AudioWorklet → `send-audio-frame`), screenshot queue (`capture-screen-still` → `send-image-content`), `sendTextMessage`, theme system, platform flags, `window.cheatingDaddy`. `legacyStartCapture` and `legacyStopCapture` (renderer.js:218-310, 580-614) are dead code with no callers.
- `src/audio-worklet.js`: AudioWorkletProcessor that turns float channels into 40 ms Int16 frames.
- `src/utils/sessionController.js`: meeting lifecycle state machine (idle → starting → active → stopping) used by CheatingDaddyApp.
- `src/utils/visibleAnswerRange.js`: virtualisation window (30 answers) for AssistantView.
- `src/utils/windowResize.js`: `update-sizes` invoke helper; no callers.

**UI components (lit ES modules)**
- `components/app/CheatingDaddyApp.js`: root element. View routing, IPC listeners (answer-event, stop-meeting-requested, update-status, click-through-toggled, reconnect-failed, whisper-downloading, stealth-hidden-changed), session start via SessionController (`providerMode` default 'cloud'), update check against the raw.githubusercontent package.json, `view-changed` send.
- `components/app/AppHeader.js`: header bar, version check, Hide shortcut hint.
- `components/views/MainView.js`: start screen. Provider mode selector (cloud token, Gemini key, Groq key, Ollama settings); Cmd/Ctrl+Enter starts a session.
- `components/views/AssistantView.js`: answer cards (marked plus highlight.js), navigation and scroll IPC listeners, text input, Analyze Screen.
- `components/views/CustomizeView.js`: preferences, keybind editor (`update-keybinds`), Google Search toggle (`update-google-search-setting`), clear data plus quit.
- `components/views/HelpView.js`: keybind cheat-sheet and links.
- `components/views/HistoryView.js`: archived sessions via `storage:*`.
- `components/views/OnboardingView.js`: first-run slides.
- `components/views/AICustomizeView.js`: custom prompt and profile editing.
- `components/views/FeedbackView.js`: POSTs feedback to `https://api.cheatingdaddy.com/api/feedback`, detects OS via navigator.platform.
- `components/views/sharedPageStyles.js`: shared CSS.
- `components/index.js`: barrel export, not loaded by index.html; exports a nonexistent `AdvancedView.js`.

## 3. Provider modes and data flow
`currentProviderMode` in gemini.js is set by the `initialize-*` handlers. The renderer-side mode comes from `prefs.providerMode || 'cloud'` (CheatingDaddyApp.js:748; renderer.js:697 chooses the capture sample rate: 24000 for cloud, 16000 otherwise).

**Audio in (all modes)**
- **macOS (default speaker_only)**: renderer `invoke('start-macos-audio')` → gemini.js:2110 → `startMacOSAudioCapture` (1509) runs `pkill -x SystemAudioDump`, then spawns `SystemAudioDump` (`process.resourcesPath` when packaged, else `src/assets`). stdout is 24 kHz s16 stereo. It is chunked to 40 ms and converted to mono, then sent to cloud (`sendCloudAudio`), local (`processLocalAudio` 24k→16k), byok (`enqueueLivePcm` 24k→16k), or the Groq fallback (`processAudioForWhisper`). The macOS path also starts `liveGapFiller`. Mic (mic_only/both) uses getUserMedia → AudioWorklet → `send-audio-frame`.
- **Windows/Linux**: `getLoopbackStream` → `navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({video 1 fps, audio {sampleRate, mono, no AEC/NS/AGC}})` → main handler `{video: sources[0], audio:'loopback'}` → AudioContext(sampleRate) + `meeting-pcm-processor` → `ipcRenderer.invoke('send-audio-frame', {generation, source, sequence, capturedAt, sampleRate, pcm})` (renderer.js:677). The renderer stops sending when 50 sends are already pending. Main: `validateAudioFrame` → `routeAudioFrame` (gemini.js:1819). Cloud gets raw PCM over the ws, local goes to `processLocalAudio`, byok goes to `enqueueLivePcm` (16k passthrough) → `BoundedAudioQueue` → `drainGeminiQueue` (it backs off when ws bufferedBytes > 64 KB and closes the session after 2 s of congestion) → `sendRealtimeInput({audio:{mimeType:'audio/pcm;rate=16000'}})`. The gap filler is never started on this path.

**BYOK (Gemini API key)**
- Start: `initialize-gemini(apiKey, customPrompt, profile, language)` → `initializeGeminiSession` → `connectGeminiLive` with model `gemini-3.8-live` (gemini.js:66) at the BidiGenerateContent websocket, with tools `search_meeting` (BLOCKING function) and optionally `googleSearch`.
- Answers: Live `outputTranscription` text (AUDIO modality, with the spoken answer's transcript used as text) → `ingestLiveOutputTranscription` → `emitAnswer` → `answer-event` start/update/complete → `CheatingDaddyApp.handleAnswerEvent`. Turn end comes from `turnComplete`, the watchdog or a client silence timer. `inputTranscription` drives `scheduleCodeAnswerForVoiceTurn`. Code questions also stream a separate card from `gemini-3.8-flash` (`generateContentStream`, @google/genai HTTPS).
- Screenshots: renderer `capture-screen-still` (main desktopCapturer JPEG) → `send-image-content`. With an API key the 'http' path sends `gemini-3.8-flash` `generateContentStream` with the image plus prompt (analyzeScreenSend.js:65). The answer is streamed to the renderer, then the image and answer are pushed into Live with `sendClientContent(turnComplete:false)`. If that returns no text, it falls back to a forced Live turn (`sendClientContent` with turnComplete:true).
- Typed text: `send-text-message` → `dispatchLiveTypedTurn` → `sendRealtimeInput({text})`. It is queued (max 3) while a Live turn is active.
- Groq fallback (byok with a Groq key and no Live session): STT `whisper-large-v3-turbo` at api.groq.com/openai/v1/audio/transcriptions, chat at /chat/completions with the daily-limited model from `getModelForToday` (qwen3-32b / gpt-oss-120b / gpt-oss-20b per storage limits), image `meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct`. Visual keywords trigger `auto-capture-screenshot`. Gemma path: `gemma-3-27b-it`. Meeting summary: `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` after 12 turns.

**Cloud (cheatingdaddy.com token)**
- `initialize-cloud(token, profile, customPrompt)` → `connectCloud` (wss://api.cheatingdaddy.com/ws?token=…, 10 s timeout) → sends `{type:'set_config', profile, user_context}`.
- Audio: binary PCM frames (24 kHz from the worklet; macOS SystemAudioDump frames are 24 kHz mono). They are dropped if bufferedAmount > 96000.
- Text: `{type:'test_text', text}`. Image: `{type:'image', image}`, followed by text.
- Answers: server `response_start/response_chunk/response_end` → `answer-event`. `transcription` → status.

**Local (Ollama + Whisper)**
- `initialize-local(host, model, whisperModel, profile, prompt)` → Ollama connectivity test, then `@huggingface/transformers` pipeline('automatic-speech-recognition', model, {dtype:'q8', device:'auto'}), model cache in `userData/whisper-models`.
- Audio → 16k RMS VAD → Whisper → `ollamaClient.chat({stream:true})` → `answer-event`.
- Screenshots and typed text use `sendLocalImage` (Ollama `images:[base64]`) or `sendLocalText`.

## 6. Persistent state
- **Config dir** (storage.js:44-57): win32 `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Roaming\cheating-daddy-config`, darwin `~/Library/Application Support/cheating-daddy-config`, other platforms `~/.config/cheating-daddy-config`. It is independent of Electron `userData`.
  - `config.json`: configVersion 1, onboarded, layout. A version mismatch triggers re-init via `initializeStorage`.
  - `credentials.json`: **plaintext** `apiKey` (Gemini), `groqApiKey`, `cloudToken`.
  - `preferences.json`: customPrompt, selectedProfile, selectedLanguage, audioMode (default speaker_only), backgroundTransparency, googleSearchEnabled, vadPreset, ollamaHost/Model, whisperModel, theme, and `providerMode`, which is absent from the defaults so the code falls back to 'cloud'.
  - `keybinds.json`: null means platform defaults. On win32 a saved `Ctrl+\\` toggle is migrated to `Alt` (window.js:236-239).
  - `limits.json`: per-day Groq and Gemma character counters.
  - `history/`: `<sessionId>.jsonl` turn and screen records plus `<sessionId>.meta.json` (legacy `<id>.json` is still readable).
- **Electron paths**: `app.getPath('logs')/diagnostics/performance.jsonl` (rotated ×3 at 5 MB). `app.getPath('userData')/whisper-models` (local mode Whisper cache). The default session's Chromium localStorage is read by `getStoredSetting` through executeJavaScript, which is legacy.
- **In-memory only**: conversationHistory, screenAnalysisHistory, Live resumption handle, last screenshot JPEG, typed-turn queue.
